content.value_statement: Influencer traffic often drops when a landing page does not match the creator message or offer. This skill audits the page and produces a prioritized conversion plan with CTA, promo code, social proof, and A/B test recommendations.
actual_capabilities: Capture campaign context, current conversion rate, influencer message, promo code, audience, and goal.
Score message match across message, value proposition, offer, product, and tone.
Recommend page structure for influencer traffic, including hero, proof, product, FAQ, and final CTA sections.
Prioritize CTA, promo code, friction, and mobile conversion fixes.
Create an A/B test roadmap with hypotheses, variants, metrics, sample size, and duration.
Define tracking metrics, UTM parameters, and events for attribution.
limitations: It relies on user-provided analytics unless optional connectors are available.
It does not measure results after launch; use a performance analysis workflow for that.
Expected conversion impact is directional and should be validated with tests.
It recommends changes but cannot publish them without a connected CMS or page builder.

use_cases.title: Fix creator traffic drop-off
use_cases.description: Audit a campaign page when creator clicks are not converting into purchases or leads.

use_cases.title: Improve promo-code flow
use_cases.description: Make an influencer offer clearer, easier to apply, and easier to track through checkout.

use_cases.title: Plan dedicated creator pages
use_cases.description: Decide when a partner needs a custom page and define the personalized sections.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a creator page
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a basic landing page review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Optimize our landing page for influencer traffic from [campaign]. The page is [URL]. Current conversion rate is [rate]. The creator is [handle]. The promo code is [code].

prompt_templates.title: Score message match
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the creator message and page copy may not align.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare [creator message] with our page headline, offer, proof, and CTA. Give a message match score and the top fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a creator page
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a creator partnership may need a dedicated page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a dedicated landing page for [creator] promoting [product]. Include hero copy, proof placement, promo code treatment, CTA plan, and tracking events.

prompt_templates.title: Build a test roadmap
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for prioritizing experiments after an audit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this page audit and analytics summary: [details]. Prioritize A/B tests for headline, hero proof, CTA, promo code, and mobile conversion. Include hypotheses, variants, assumptions, duration, and success metrics.

output_examples.input: A creator campaign page has 1.2% conversion, weak mobile performance, and a promo code users must type manually.
output: Diagnosis: Message match is weak because the hero does not reflect the creator message.
Priority fixes: add creator proof near the hero, show the code, lift the mobile CTA, and align the headline.
Test plan: test headline and hero proof first, then test CTA copy after the first result.

output_examples.input: A brand wants a landing page for a long-term creator partnership with a unique offer.
output: Recommendation: Create a dedicated creator page because the partner has unique proof, offer, and traffic volume.
Page plan: personalized hero, creator quote, featured products, exclusive offer, FAQ, and final purchase CTA.
Tracking plan: use creator URL, promo code, UTM campaign, CTA clicks, add-to-cart, and purchase events.

output_examples.input: A creator page loads slowly and loses mobile users before they reach the checkout CTA.
output: Mobile fixes: compress media, show the primary CTA early, simplify forms, and show shipping details sooner.
Measurement: track page load time, bounce rate, scroll depth, add-to-cart rate, and conversion rate.

best_practices: Share the creator message, current page copy, offer details, and conversion goal before asking for fixes.
Use creator-specific proof near the first CTA when traffic comes from that creator.
Validate predicted impact with one focused A/B test before rolling out broad changes.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for a full redesign when only the offer or message match is broken.
Do not hide the promo code or require users to remember it at checkout.
Do not compare results across campaigns without consistent UTMs and conversion events.

faq.question: Does this skill need analytics access?
faq.answer: No. It can work from user-provided metrics. Connected analytics improves accuracy when available.

faq.question: Can it create landing page copy?
faq.answer: Yes. It can suggest headline, subheadline, CTA, FAQ, and social proof copy.

faq.question: Does it build or publish pages?
faq.answer: No. It gives implementation guidance. Publishing requires your CMS, page builder, or developer.

faq.question: Can it help with paid ads traffic?
faq.answer: Yes. The same message match workflow can apply to paid landing pages when offer details are known.

faq.question: Will it guarantee higher conversion?
faq.answer: No. It estimates impact and recommends tests. You should validate changes with measured experiments.

faq.question: How is this different from campaign performance analysis?
faq.answer: This skill improves the pre-sale landing experience. Performance analysis measures results after the campaign runs.
